accounting.raw_full_preallocated: already-written raw bytes are not also charged as outstanding reservations
accounting.original_charge: committed actual sizes + unfinalized original reservations + unreserved orphan actual sizes
accounting.base_and_definition_admission: measured immutable artifact sizes and current/staged generations charged before run/update; no unbounded copy or retained candidate
accounting.runtime_spool_excludes: separately reserved detailed report file and SQLite/log pools
accounting.retained_run_evidence: finished scan and update run control files, including per-run integrated watchdog events, stay charged to detailed_report_pool until retention removes them; update final reports and their pending copies are charged to update_report_pool
accounting.normalized_logs_scope: normalized_logs_all_rotations covers host-wide rotating diagnostic logs; per-run integrated watchdog events are run control evidence bounded by integrated_watchdog_normalized_events_ram
accounting.cleanup_failure: keep outstanding reservation until writer exit, fd closure, owned-file deletion and required synchronization confirmed

admission.wal_checkpoint_busy: stop new writes/intakes before normal transaction reserve plus 32 MiB terminal WAL reserve is consumed; never assume a journal_size_limit readback bounded active WAL
admission.db_tombstones: retained without silent reset; refuse new work before terminal reserve is consumed
admission.full_io_or_sync_error: fail closed; never promote incomplete report/result or release reservations from elapsed time
admission.scan_report_larger_than_bound: reject report and keep confirmed rejection evidence independently

measurement_boundary: budget_probe.py uses explicitly smaller SQLite caps to induce SQLITE_FULL and pinned-reader WAL growth; those reduced values are not product limits
